events.title: Todd Rundgren review – try-anything veteran doesn’t let his freak flag fully fly

sources.title: Todd Rundgren review – try-anything veteran doesn’t let his freak flag fully fly
sources.description: Cadogan Hall, London The 78-year-old has astonishing range but gets bogged down in middling rock, though later delivers some gorgeous acoustic songs – and a slinky Marvin Gaye cover Todd Rundgren is a confusing man. After his tune-packed 1972 album Something/Anything? drew comparisons to Carole King and Brian Wilson, he took a pharmacopoeia of psychedelics and made a vexing masterpiece, A Wizard, a True Star, with no singles at all. He’s produced classic albums by Meat Loaf and the New York Dolls but he’s also released a record of nothing but vocals (A Cappella) and the world’s first interactive album (No World Order). Counting only the artists who appeared on his last two albums, his fans include Trent Reznor, Robyn and the Lemon Twigs. He called his memoir The Individualist. Rundgren certainly looks the part. With his Addams Family hair, tinted goggles and limber dance moves, he could be a goth raver. Everything he says sounds teasingly sarcastic, even when he’s thanking the audience for spending their “discretionary income” on a ticket. He says the curfew means he can’t tell stories about the songs but it would have been worth sacrificing a couple of his two-hour show’s stodgier numbers to hear them. Continue reading...

supplement.title: 证监会：今年前8个月罚没款将近100亿

sources.title: 证监会：今年前8个月罚没款将近100亿
sources.description: 中新网9月10日电 10日下午，国务院新闻办公室举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会。中国证监会副主席李超介绍，证监会坚持依法从严监管，坚决打击各类违法违规行为。今年前8个月查办证券期货违法案件644件，罚没款将近100亿。通过各类方式为投资者挽回损失50多亿元。下一步，证监会将着力提高资本市场监管和治理水平，不断完善准入、持续监管、退市和交易、机构等全链条监管体系，加快构建行政、刑事、民事的有效衔接的追责体系，促进人工智能在资本市场规范应用，推进监管的数智化转型，加强新型业务监管和风险防控。
